sentences.text: The in-force UCB directions say that for loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 2026-01-01, pre-payment charges are not to be levied for all floating rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, and that in other cases pre-payment charges, if any, are as per the approved policy of the UCB.
The product note says that for non-individual borrowers, a foreclosure charge of 2% of the principal outstanding applies.

On the evidence provided, I cannot determine whether that product note conflicts with the RBI pre-payment rules because applicability of the relevant UCB direction depends on the sanction date, and that date is not provided.

missing.searched: Checked the provided RBI UCB directions and rule findings for whether paragraph 261 applies to this loan; the findings say sanction_date is needed, but no sanction date was provided.
